# Task schedule

The recurring safety tasks defined in this safety concept are scheduled as follows.

| Task | Frequency | Responsible | Reference |
| ---- | --------- | ----------- | --------- |
| Safety introduction for new lab and workshop users, incl. maternity protection information | before first entry | GSR / BSO | [Appendix 8](08_training_certificates.qmd) |
| Annual safety refresher for all users, incl. maternity protection information | yearly | GSR / BSO | [Appendix 8](08_training_certificates.qmd) |
| Biosafety instruction for persons working with Group 2 organisms | before starting, then yearly | BSO | [Biological Safety](../biological-safety.qmd#measures_iii) |
| Review of the BSL2 access list | every six months | BSO | [Biological Safety, Appendix 7](../_biological/07_user_list_with_access_to_BSL2.qmd) |
| Update of the biological project list | every six months and with each new ECOGEN notification | BSO | [Biological Safety, Appendix 6](../_biological/06_project_list.qmd) |
| Chemical inventory; disposal of expired chemicals | twice per year | GSR | [Chemical Safety](../chemical-safety.qmd) |
| Inspection and certification of the biological safety cabinet | yearly | BSO, service company | [Biological Safety, Appendix 13](../_biological/13_service_plan.qmd) |
| Cleaning of incubator, fridge, and centrifuge | every six months | BSO | [Biological Safety, Appendix 11](../_biological/11_hygene_plan.qmd) |
| Safety check of the 3D printer enclosure and ventilation | every six months | GSR | [Appendix 7](07_maintenance_and_service_schedule.qmd#safety-check-log) |
| Review of the hazard identification and risk assessment | yearly and before each new activity | professor, GSR | [Appendix 3](03_hazard_identification_and_risk_assessment.qmd) |
| Clean-up of the lab and workshop | twice per year | all users | - |
| Review of the safety concept; update of BED-B | yearly and whenever the risk situation changes | GSR / BSO | [Biological Safety](../biological-safety.qmd#emergency_v) |
